en: A vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with three photographic panels. The upper two show streets with wooden houses and verandas, while the lower larger view shows a substantial multi‑storey wooden building with many windows next to a church with a tall spire and other smaller buildings, with open fields in the foreground. Around and between the images there is cursive handwriting and small labels indicating places. The layout and handwriting suggest an early 20th‑century correspondence postcard.
